note: This skill can operate nodes with real funds. Automated evals should avoid live sends unless they use a disposable test node and explicit user approval. Safe paths include config inspection, node status, decode, decode-qr, receive on test nodes, pay dry-run, and tracking known historical payments.

evals.prompt: generate a 5000 sat invoice as a qr code
evals.expected_output: Confirms configuration, creates an invoice with `scripts/lnpay receive 5000 --qr <path>`, round-trip verifies the QR image, and surfaces the bolt11 plus hex payment_hash.

evals.prompt: pay this invoice [photo of a Lightning QR code]
evals.expected_output: Decodes the QR with `scripts/lnpay decode-qr` or `scripts/lnpay pay @image`, shows amount/description/destination/expiry, stops at dry-run, asks for explicit confirmation, then verifies confirmed successful sends with `scripts/lnpay track <invoice>`.
files: a phone photo of a BOLT11 QR

evals.prompt: is our lightning node healthy and how much can it send?
evals.expected_output: Runs `lnpay config` and `lnpay node`; reports sync state, active channels, spendable local balance, and inbound remote balance.

evals.prompt: watch that invoice and tell me when it gets paid
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/lnpay watch <payment_hash|bolt11>` in the background; on settlement reports SETTLED and amount received, or reports timeout/canceled state.

evals.prompt: what route did that lightning payment use?
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/lnpay track <payment_hash|bolt11>`; reports local node alias if configured, every successful HTLC part, route aliases, pubkeys/channel IDs, actual fee, preimage, and payment index when available.

evals.prompt: generate an onchain address on our lnd
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/lnpay newaddress` (default p2wkh native SegWit) and returns the fresh bc1q address; offers np2wkh or p2tr as alternatives when relevant, without hand-writing a raw kubectl exec.
